description.value: Plateau Pizza is a family-owned gourmet pizzeria that has served the Westwood Plateau neighbourhood in Coquitlam since 1999. Known for handcrafted pizzas with slow-fermented dough, house-made sauce, and 100% mozzarella, the menu spans classic and specialty pies alongside calzones, pasta, and salads. The restaurant offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery, with gluten-free crust and vegan cheese options available.
